“我日你哥，这还是国内吗？”
林奇看着眼前的卧室有些懵逼。
身为知名游戏原画师的林奇在加完班开车回家的路上被迎面而来的大运给撞成了旺旺雪饼。
你哥的，半夜的国道真不是人走的。
俩大运开着远光并排而行直接给林奇来了个无处可躲。
他看着眼前完全陌生的环境陷入了沉思。
难不成这大运真的是异世界穿越指定工具？
可是这是哪？这还是国内吗？
给哥们干哪来了？
他打量着眼前这个不到二十平米的卧室。
一张单人床，一个书桌，一个椅子。
桌子上摆放着一个镜子一个油灯和一个画着鬼画符的图纸。
这土到掉渣的房间装修对于林奇这个游戏公司的原画师来说就是一种折磨。
太没审美了。
他拿起桌子上的镜子，借着油灯的光亮看清了自己的面容。
这是一张年轻人的脸。
蓝色的眼睛，金色的头发。

密码的，来世愿做种花家！
怎么给哥们人种都变了？
然而他看着眼前的这张脸却发现越看越熟悉。
“不会的，不会的。穿越进自己公司的游戏里还成为了自己第一个画的角色，这种事怎么可能发生呢？”
林奇不愿相信事实。
他再仔细看了一眼手中的镜子。
密码的，越看越像啊喂！
这不就是没洗头再加上熬了几天夜显得有些虚弱的伊萨里斯·罗兰吗？？？
我怎么穿成他了啊喂！
伊萨里斯·罗兰。
现实世界首款运用了体感全沉浸技术打造的游戏——【终末纪元】里的一位角色。
也是林奇在大学毕业加入公司后第一个由自己独立完成亲手所画的角色。
【终末纪元】是一款由超级ai模型所创造的游戏。
由林奇的公司阿波罗游戏工作室将底层代码喂给ai，然后由ai丰富世界观和主线剧情的世界首款全沉浸网游。
也是首款实现通过游戏休眠仓进入的游戏。
借着让人们于睡梦中在另一个世界遨游的噱头，这款游戏在上线初期就迅速在世界范围爆红。
可是穿越成谁不好，偏偏是伊萨里斯·罗兰？
作为林奇进入公司后第一个主笔的角色，伊萨里斯可以说是林奇的炫技之作。
金色的柔软秀发，兼具西方立体的五官和东方柔和的轮廓，相当伟大的一张脸。
（读者老爷照照镜子就看到了）

而且将原画投进ai之后创作的背景也相当奇异，可以说是主角模板。
伊萨里斯·罗兰，是维里迪亚帝国吻痕镇最大的贵族罗兰家族的私生子。
他的母亲是罗兰家族的长女萨沙·罗兰，父亲是一个浪迹天涯的老牛仔。
总而言之比起凄美的爱情故事这更像是一个贵族小姐年少无知被渣男骗财骗色。
他的母亲在他六七岁时便去世了，而他的父亲更是一个只在乎每个月从罗兰家族拿抚养费来买几瓶好酒的酒鬼。

"I'm your brother, is this still in China?"
Lin Qi looked at the bedroom in front of him in confusion.
As a well-known game original artist, Lynch was hit by the oncoming luck on his way home after working overtime and turned into a snow cake.
Damn it, your brother, the national highway in the middle of the night is really not for people to walk on.
The two guys were driving side by side with their high beams on, leaving Lynch with nowhere to hide.
He looked at the completely unfamiliar environment in front of him and fell into deep thought.
Is it possible that this great luck is really the designated tool for traveling to another world?
But where is this? Is this still domestic?
Where did you do it for my brother?
He looked at the bedroom in front of him, which was less than twenty square meters.
A single bed, a desk, and a chair.
On the table were a mirror, an oil lamp and a drawing with ghost drawings on it.
This shabby room decoration is a kind of torture for Lynch, the original artist of the game company.
It’s so unaesthetic.
He picked up the mirror on the table and saw his face clearly by the light of the oil lamp.
This is the face of a young man.
Blue eyes, blond hair.
Password, I would like to be a flower grower in the next life!
Why did my brother's race change?
However, when he looked at the face in front of him, he found that the more he looked at it, the more familiar it became.
"No, no way. I traveled into my own company's game and became the first character I drew. How could this happen?"
Lynch didn't want to believe the truth.
He took another closer look at the mirror in his hand.
It’s a password. The more I look at it, the more it looks like!
Isn't this Isaris Roland who didn't wash his hair and looked a little weak after staying up for a few nights? ? ?
Why am I dressed as him? Hey!
Isharis Roland.
A character in [End Age], the first game in the real world that uses full somatosensory immersion technology.
It was also the first character that Lynch drew independently after joining the company after graduating from college.
[End Age] is a game created by a super AI model.
Lynch's company Apollo Game Studio feeds the underlying code to AI, and then AI enriches the world view and main plot of the world's first fully immersive online game.
It is also the first game to be entered through the game hibernation compartment.
With the gimmick of allowing people to travel to another world in their sleep, this game quickly became popular around the world in the early days of its launch.
But it’s not good to be someone in time travel, but Isaris Roland?
As Lynch's first main character after entering the company, Isharis can be said to be Lynch's dazzling work.
Soft golden hair, a combination of Western three-dimensional facial features and Eastern soft contours, a rather great face.
(Readers will see it when they look in the mirror)
Moreover, the background created after the original painting was put into AI is also quite strange. It can be said to be the template of the protagonist.
Isharis Roland is the illegitimate son of the Roland family, the largest noble family in Hickey Town of the Viridian Empire.
His mother is Sasha Rowland, the eldest daughter of the Rowland family, and his father is an old cowboy who wanders around the world.
All in all, rather than a poignant love story, this is more like a young and ignorant aristocratic lady being defrauded of money and sex by a scumbag.
His mother died when he was six or seven years old, and his father was an alcoholic who only cared about getting alimony from the Roland family to buy a few bottles of good wine every month.
